question: Which of the following sports can be played both at individual level and with a team?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Badminton**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Badminton** can be played both as an individual sport (singles) and as a team sport (doubles or mixed doubles).
 
• In singles, one player competes against another, focusing on individual skills, agility, and strategy.
 
• In doubles or mixed doubles, two players form a team and compete against another team, requiring coordination, communication, and teamwork.
 
• Badminton is a highly versatile sport and is governed by the **Badminton World Federation (BWF)** internationally.
